_note: UI samples used by sfx/render.py (clicks + typing). None are shipped: common/kit.py synthesises procedural voices for every role when a sample file is missing. A run may drop its own licensed samples here (ui-click.mp3, ui-typing.mp3, or a set-a/ folder with an index.json) to replace the procedural ones.

ui-click.role: click / tap / send press (optional sample; procedural when missing)

ui-typing.role: typing run, looped (optional sample; procedural when missing)
